summary: Iteration 3 backend regression for Vortex Lotto Global Karma 2026 after randomness pipeline update (ANU keyless legacy buffer + 62s cooldown + crypto fallback, rejection-sampled RandomPool with per-source maxval). All 17 pytest tests pass (17/17, 100%). Verified: GET /api/games returns exactly {EJ,L649,GS,FR}; POST /api/quantum/draw returns correct shapes for every game — EJ 5 unique main in 1-50 + 2 unique extras 1-12, L649 6 unique main in 1-49 + 1 extra 0-9, GS 7 digits 0-9 (repetition allowed), FR 7 unique main in 1-38 (no extra); GET /api/projects total=107; POST/GET/DELETE /api/draws CRUD plus 404-on-double-delete, plus 400 for invalid/unknown game; GET /api/analysis?game=EJ returns counts (full 1..50 range), hot, cold, totalDraws, max. New tests for GET /api/karma/random confirm: ALLE returns poolSize=107 and a real project; AUGSBURG restricts category and poolSize matches /projects count for AUGSBURG over 5 samples; unknown category yields 404. 'source' field is accepted as 'quantum' OR 'crypto' (test relaxed from iter1); during this run all samples returned 'crypto' which is expected under the 1/min ANU rate limit and is documented as valid by the spec.

minor.issue: Backend logs show repeated 'ANU legacy API failed: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)' — the keyless jsonI.php endpoint is returning non-JSON (likely HTML/empty body) under rate-limit/maintenance. Fallback to crypto works correctly. Non-blocking; consider logging once per cooldown window instead of every fetch attempt.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Throttle the ANU legacy warning log — it currently fires on every refill attempt when the upstream returns non-JSON. A single WARN per cooldown is enough.
OPTIONAL (carry-over from iter1): Migrate deprecated react-native-web style props (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents prop) on the frontend — does not affect backend.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _refill_buffer correctly respects 62s cooldown for keyless endpoint and resets _last_fetch BEFORE the network call to prevent thundering herd retries — good.
RandomPool.pick uses rejection sampling with per-source maxval (256 for uint8, 65536 for uint16/crypto) — eliminates modulo bias. Good.
All endpoints under /api prefix, env vars accessed without defaults (fails fast), MongoDB _id excluded via projection — clean.
karma_random uses make_pool(8) and rejection sampling for index selection — uniform distribution preserved.
Minor: ANU API failure path in _fetch_anu_legacy logs warning even on rate-limit 503/HTML responses — could be quieter.
